scientific_integrity: Analytical arguments prove the infinite-dimensional results; a finite combinatorial checker is supplementary. Earlier definitions and isolated shift counterexamples are acknowledged. There is no claim of exclusive publication priority.
scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes nonzero contractive unilateral weights with moduli tending to one. The priority comparison of the 2022 Ramesh--Osaka article was limited to its abstract because complete text was not accessible. No statement about zero weights, arbitrary bounded operators, or independent proof verification is made.
title: A sharp gcd threshold for reducing-subspace norm attainment of weighted-shift powers
